{{Youmay|the watercraft|Kirk Windjammer's anti-grav loader, the ''[[Seaskimmer]]''}}
A '''seaskimmer''' was a type of small [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] vehicle. They were common on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Jerrilek]] and [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], similar to a [[wavespeeder]]. They were utilized to gather up nets in the waters around [[Foamwander City]] during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and entered the [[City/Legends|city]] via access ports.
